_about: Every word on the Skills screens (/skills, a skill's page, the editor) and in the skills picker in the chat box. The skills themselves are the .md files in this folder.
title: Skills
subtitle: Saved instructions LeadPlus can run on an account, a campaign or your whole workspace.
readOnlyHint: System skills are maintained by LeadPlus and cannot be edited.
emptyTab: No skills here yet. Use New skill to write one.
_tabsAbout: The tabs on /skills. 'all' shows every skill; the others show one scope.
_scopesAbout: The badge on every skill. tone is a colour from the tone palette: grey, blue, amber, green or teal.
_categoriesAbout: The groups on /skills, in this order. A skill's category in its .md file must be one of these ids.
_inputsAbout: What a skill can run on. label is shown on the skill's page, picker is the label in front of the dropdown in the chat box.
